dialogue.instruction: El Granjero Tom te pregunta qué hiciste ayer en el mundo. Lee el chat y elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno. Tema: pasado simple.

turns.npc: Hi! What did you do yesterday?
Cool! Did you build a house?

options.text: Yes, I builded a big house.
Yes, I built a big house.
Yes, I build a big house yesterday.

turns.npc: Nice! What did the zombie do at night?
Scary! How did you win the fight?
